title: REALM: An RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold for Cross-Modal Perception
abstract: arXiv:2605.00271v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Event cameras provide several unique advantages over standard frame-based sensors, including high temporal resolution, low latency, and robustness to extreme lighting. However, existing learning-based approaches for event processing are typically confined to narrow, task-specific silos and lack the ability to generalize across modalities. We address this gap with REALM, a cross-modal framework that learns an RGB- and Event-Aligned Latent Manifold by projecting event representations into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models. Instead of task-specific training, we leverage low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to bridge the modality gap, effectively unlocking the geometric and semantic priors of frozen RGB backbones for asynchronous event streams. translated_title: REALM：用于跨模态感知的RGB与事件对齐潜在流形
translated_abstract: 事件相机相较于标准帧式传感器具有多项独特优势，包括高时间分辨率、低延迟以及对极端光照条件的鲁棒性。然而，现有基于学习的事件处理方法通常局限于狭窄的、特定任务的孤岛中，缺乏跨模态泛化的能力。我们通过REALM来弥补这一空白，这是一个跨模态框架，通过将事件表示投影到RGB基础模型的预训练潜在空间中，学习RGB与事件对齐的潜在流形。我们不再采用特定任务的训练，而是利用低秩适应（LoRA）来弥合模态差距，有效地为异步事件流解锁冻结的RGB骨干网络中的几何和语义先验。我们证明了REALM能够有效地将事件映射到基于ViT的基础模型潜在空间中。我们的方法可以执行下游任务，例如深度估计和语义分割。
tldr: REALM提出了一种跨模态框架，利用LoRA将事件相机数据投影到预训练RGB基础模型的潜在空间中，实现事件与RGB模态的对齐，从而无需任务特定训练即可完成深度估计和语义分割等下游任务。
en_tdlr: REALM is a cross-modal framework that uses LoRA to project event camera data into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models, aligning the two modalities and enabling downstream tasks like depth estimation and semantic segmentation without task-specific training.
